description: Feature sets for progressive Bayesian hierarchical experiments. B0 = no environmental covariates (municipality random effect only). B5 uses the exact 5 official XAI concept columns from outputs/xai/perfiles_conceptuales.csv (raw, unscaled). All other sets use pre-engineered columns from data_processed/features_parcela.csv. Location columns (loc_*) are deliberately excluded to avoid absorbing municipality structure.

notes.B5: Exact official concepts. Verified against engineered features: C4a==clim_prec_temp (r=1.0), C5a==topo_elev_media (r=1.0), C2a approx s2_ndvi_amp (r=0.95), C1a/C3a are season means not exactly reproducible from window means (r~0.77-0.81).
notes.B20: 8 additional columns chosen for a blend of canopy, moisture, phenology timing, frost and geometry.
